# Pocket TTS (English)

Kyutai · released 2026-01

kyutai/pocket-tts default English model (100M parameters, CPU-oriented). The default English weights have been updated in place (english.yaml now equals english\_2026-09; the launch weights were english\_2026-01). The voice-cloning repo is gated; without access the CLI falls back to kyutai/pocket-tts-without-voice-cloning. Weights CC BY 4.0, code MIT.

[Model and usage documentation](https://huggingface.co/kyutai/pocket-tts)

No reviewed benchmark results yet. This catalogue entry has no score or rank.

## How to run it

```sh
uvx pocket-tts generate --text "Hello world, this is a test."
```
